name: Windows File Explorer
layout_summary: Top strip: folder tabs with '+' button. Below tabs: Back, Forward, Up arrow, long breadcrumb Address Bar in center, and 'Search' box at top-right. Below navigation: command toolbar (New, Cut, Copy, Paste, Rename, Delete, Sort, View). Left pane: Quick Access / This PC navigation tree. Main pane: files and folders grid/list.
avoid_traps: Clicking the middle of the breadcrumb address bar may click a folder segment button instead of allowing text entry — always use press_key('ctrl+l') or press_key('alt+d') to focus the address bar as editable text.
Single-clicking a folder in the main pane only selects it; press 'enter' after selecting or use ctrl+l to navigate directly by path.

focus_address_bar.verify: Address bar highlights full folder path for typing

search_folder.visual_fallback: smart_type('Search box at top-right', query, submit=true)
search_folder.verify: File Explorer searches current directory for matching files

new_folder.visual_fallback: smart_click('New button in top command bar') -> smart_click('Folder')
new_folder.verify: New folder is created with editable name highlighted

rename_item.visual_fallback: smart_click('Rename icon in top command bar')
rename_item.verify: Selected file or folder name becomes an editable text box

parent_folder.visual_fallback: smart_click('Up arrow button left of address bar')

go_back.verify: Navigates back to the previously visited folder

close_window.verify: File Explorer window or tab closes
